title: Wendell and the Verdict
author: Lena Ishikawa
blurb: Ivo Iversen, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the trial begins.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
